How ordering works

1

Pick & personalize

Choose the product and size. Add a logo — yours, or one we already have on file for your group — and type the engraving exactly how you want it.

2

Approve the proof

We email you a proof showing your logo and text on the product. Nothing gets made until you say it looks right.

3

We make it

Engraving, etching, or printing happens right here in West Valley. Tell us your need-by date at checkout and we will plan around it.

4

Pick up or ship

Pick it up at the shop, or have it shipped. Either way, the order that reaches us carries your size, text, logo file, and date — no email back-and-forth.

Specialty logos, ready to go

Groups we work with keep their approved logo on file — a school, a team, a company, or a group like the Honorary Colonels. Members just pick the logo when they order; no uploading, no guessing. ZILLIDEX is the example logo built into this demo: open any plaque, tumbler, mug, or award and you will see it on the product. You can also upload your own logo there to try it.
